sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionCategory,
    sum(o.SalesAmount) AS discounted_online_revenue,
    sum(o.DiscountAmount) * 100.0 / nullIf(sum(o.SalesAmount + o.DiscountAmount), 0) AS average_discount_percent
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS o
INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
    ON o.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE o.PromotionKey != 1
  AND o.DiscountAmount > 0
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY discounted_online_revenue DESC
